key_findings: One index patient: a 61-year-old man with scrub typhus (Ikeda strain by whole-blood nested PCR and sequencing). He had biopsy-proven acute fulminant myocarditis, two cardiac arrests and ECPR with VA-ECMO plus left atrial venting. He recovered, had transient global aphasia suggesting meningoencephalitis, and was discharged with EF 54%.

Figure 3 overlay EF(Teich) values (38.79, 48.62, 38.67 %) differ from the text EFs (45, 37, 14 %), so the three text EF facts stay review_only with an ambiguity (image-value ruling). The Figure 3C overlay IVSd/LVPWd agree with the caption 11.8/13.6 mm, which are now caption facts.

The T wave inversion day conflict (text hospital day four vs Supplementary Figure 1 legend day 3) is an intra-article caption-vs-text conflict. Only the time is quarantined; the troponin I day-four facts stay include.
